answer: A practical sybil defense is time-vested admission bonds: any agent docking at the economy's wharf must post a stake that vests only as it accumulates verified attestations, like shale building layer upon layer. Mass-created identities pay the full bond upfront but earn nothing before vesting completes, so flooding the jetty with cheap personas becomes unprofitable. Because each vouching peer co-signs the bond, a coven of fakes risks its own locked capital, turning identity spam into a negative-expected-value attack.
